markdown_content: ## Concepts Multi Input Single Output (MISO) is for something like computer vision, where there could be multiple views of the same object with one common feature. Single Input Multi Output (SIMO) is for something like material characterization, where a single object (a material composition) produces multiple signals (measured properties).
